sample_mapping_evidence: Only literal RNA barcode matches to author-provided donor/origin/vaccination metadata. No origin inferred from numeric barcode suffix. Other RNA cells remain unassigned; the retained subset is conditioned on availability of those identity annotations.
physical_sample_mapping_evidence: Sixteen explicit author origins joined to original GEX visit records across seven source participants. Repeated visits remain dependent within participant.

source_metadata.access: Public original RNA counts and coded source identity metadata.
source_metadata.source_unit: Sixteen explicit author origins joined to original GEX visit records across seven source participants. Repeated visits remain dependent within participant.
source_metadata.identity_policy: Only literal RNA barcode matches to author-provided donor/origin/vaccination metadata. No origin inferred from numeric barcode suffix. Other RNA cells remain unassigned; the retained subset is conditioned on availability of those identity annotations.
source_metadata.composition_policy: PBMC-derived CD3/CD19-enriched cells; paired-annotation identity subset is not whole-PBMC composition. Source annotation-table membership is retained without inferring biological doublet status.
source_metadata.phase_policy: Exact GEO source individuals and visit labels joined through origin. AuthorV04maps to GEOHealthyControl03via pbmc14/15, not code-number guessing. No clinical timing or individual age imputed.
source_metadata.gene_policy: All36601provided native RNA genes; per-cell normalization uses all native RNA counts. Reference gene alignment is separate for annotation.
source_metadata.demographic_policy: Individual age/sex unavailable in source GEO fields; do not impute. Preserve authorV04and GEOHealthyControl03 aliases through explicit origin.
